title: 第13章 海上钓龙第14章 熬正
content_zh:
第二日。
孙悟空和陆生，站在海边。
猴群将二人团团围住，一一告别。
老白猿看向陆生，笑呵呵道：
“二大王的感应，从未错过。”
“这一趟出海访仙，二位大王定能学得长生之法归来！”
孙悟空嘿嘿一笑：
“嘿嘿！”
“那是自然。”
“你们就等着吧，俺和老二定能成为仙人。”
“到那时，俺再教你们长生之法。”
“以后，咱们花果山所有猴子就都不用死了！”
孙悟空话音落下。
猴群顿时沸腾：
“二位大王威武！”
“二位大王威武！”
孙悟空摆手道：
“好了！”
“俺和老二要出发了。”
“你们也都回去吧！”

说完。
孙悟空背起一堆灵果，跳上海边木筏。
“老二，走吧！”
陆生应了一声，也跳上木筏。
在猴群的注视下。
孙悟空撑着木筏，渐行渐远。
……
大海上。
孙悟空望了眼一望无边的大海，叹了口气：
“老二，咱们都出海十多天了，还是看不到半点仙山的影子。”
“那些个神仙，为何非得躲在山里呢？”
陆生安慰道：
“大哥，求仙拜师讲究心诚则灵。”
“那些神仙自然也要看到我们的心意。”
“若是连这点寻仙的苦都不愿吃，那还如何修仙呢？”
孙悟空哼了声：
“这些个神仙，真是小气！”
content_en:
The second day.
Sun Wukong and Lu Sheng were standing on the beach.
The monkeys surrounded the two and said goodbye one by one.
The old white ape looked at Lu Sheng and said with a smile:
"The feeling of the two kings is never missed."
"This trip to the sea to visit immortals, the two great kings will definitely learn the method of immortality and return!"
Sun Wukong chuckled:
"Hey!"
"That's natural."
"Just wait, the second child and I will definitely become immortals."
"At that time, I will teach you the method of immortality."
"From now on, all the monkeys in our Huaguoshan Mountain won't have to die!"
Sun Wukong finished speaking.
The monkeys suddenly became excited:
"The two kings are mighty!"
"The two kings are mighty!"
Sun Wukong waved his hand and said:
"Okay!"
"The second child and I are leaving."
"You all should go back too!"
Finished.
Sun Wukong picked up a bunch of spiritual fruits and jumped onto the raft on the seaside.
"Second brother, let's go!"
Lu Sheng responded and jumped onto the raft.
Under the watchful eyes of the monkeys.
Sun Wukong held the raft and drifted away.
…
On the sea.
Sun Wukong looked at the boundless sea and sighed:
"Second brother, we have been out at sea for more than ten days, and we still can't see any shadow of the fairy mountain."
"Why do those gods have to hide in the mountains?"
Lu Sheng comforted:
"Brother, when seeking immortality and apprenticeship, one must be sincere and spiritual."
"Of course those gods also want to see our thoughts."
"If you don't even want to endure the pain of seeking immortality, how can you cultivate immortality?"
Sun Wukong snorted:
"These gods are so stingy!"
